WITH w AS (
 SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.etl_loaded_at, f.gross_amount, f.net_amount, f.sale_date
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2025-02-28')
SELECT COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ids, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) rl, COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads, MIN(etl_loaded_at), MAX(etl_loaded_at) FROM w

WITH wd AS (
 SELECT web_order_id, status, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
l AS (
 SELECT wd.dd, f.gross_amount, f.net_amount, p.category, s.store_id, f.channel_code, f.vat_rate, f.sales_line_id
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 JOIN wd ON wd.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
 WHERE s.store_id=900)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ids,
 SUM(gross_amount) gross_all, SUM(CASE WHEN category<>'ZZ Test' THEN gross_amount END) gross_ex_test,
 SUM(CASE WHEN category='ZZ Test' THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END) test_gross, SUM(net_amount) net_all,
 SUM(CASE WHEN category<>'ZZ Test' THEN net_amount END) net_ex_test
FROM l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=l.dd
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period IN (4,5,6)
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

SELECT 'lines_check' k, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) bad_gross,

WITH o AS (SELECT o.*, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) dd FROM fact_web_order o),
ln AS (SELECT receipt_id, SUM(gross_amount) g, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) orders, SUM(CASE WHEN ln.receipt_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_lines,
 SUM(CASE WHEN ln.receipt_id IS NOT NULL AND abs(ln.g-o.order_total_gross)>0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) total_mismatch,
 SUM(CASE WHEN ln.receipt_id IS NOT NULL AND ln.c<>o.line_count THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) count_mismatch,

FROM o LEFT JOIN ln ON ln.receipt_id=o.web_order_id

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(f.gross_amount), 2) AS web_sales_incl_vat
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = w.dispatch_date
WHERE s.store_id = 900
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period IN (4, 5, 6)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 2
